'''East Flatbush''' is a residential [[neighborhood]] in the [[New York City]] [[Boroughs of New York City|borough]] of [[Brooklyn]]. East Flatbush is bounded by [[Crown Heights, Brooklyn|Crown Heights]] and Empire Boulevard to the north; [[Brownsville, Brooklyn|Brownsville]] and East 98th Street to the east; [[Flatlands, Brooklyn|Flatlands]], [[Canarsie, Brooklyn|Canarsie]] and the [[Long Island Rail Road]]'s [[Bay Ridge Branch]] to the south; and the neighborhood of [[Flatbush, Brooklyn|Flatbush]] and New York Avenue to the west. East Flatbush is a predominantly black neighborhood of [[African Americans|African American]] and [[Afro-Caribbean]] persons and has a population of 135,619 as of the [[2010 United States census]].

East Flatbush is part of [[Brooklyn Community Board 17|Brooklyn Community District 17]], and its primary [[ZIP Code]] is 11203.<ref name="NYCPlanning"/> It is patrolled by the 67th Precinct of the [[New York City Police Department]].<ref name="NYPD 67th Precinct"/> Politically it is represented by the [[New York City Council]]'s 40th, 41st, and 45th Districts.<ref>[http://www.nyc.gov/html/dc/downloads/pdf/brooklyn.pdf "Current City Council Districts for Kings County"], [[New York City]]. Accessed May 5, 2017.</ref>
